name: Moganshan 3322 Homestay
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Dining Experience:Breakfast and dinner are highlighted for their quality and authenticity, with meals prepared using locally grown ingredients. The on-site dining is noted for its affordability, taste, and comparison favorably to other local restaurants.(based on 12 reviews)

topics.text: Breakfast and dinner are highlighted for their quality and authenticity, with meals prepared using locally grown ingredients. The on-site dining is noted for its affordability, taste, and comparison favorably to other local restaurants.

address: No. 11, Xiacun Village, Houwu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 房間整潔，乾淨衞生，老闆兩口子人很好，特別熱情，服務也很好。住的也很舒服，很適合來放空休閑。樓下能打桌球和搓麻將，早餐也很豐富，有包子、麪條、雞蛋、紅薯、白粥這些。還有一個點！他家紙巾都是潔柔維達這種，就沖這個細節必須給好評！！！
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 房型獨特，窗外風景青山綠水，門外小溪水嘩啦啦。走不遠可看到銀杏樹，不遠處飯店挺多，口味不錯。老闆娘人好，五一假期很忙，抽時間送我們去瑤塢，特別感謝。還會再來。
comments.author: Guest User
